title: Kuwait-flagged tanker KAZIMAH III hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: UKMTO reported the Kuwait-flagged tanker KAZIMAH III was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on 1 October, starting a fire; crew safe.
x_post: A tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on 1 October, starting a fire; crew safe, UKMTO said. Shipping media and Vanguard Tech named it as the Kuwait-flagged VLCC KAZIMAH III. #MaritimeSecurity #StraitOfHormuz #Tanker #UKMTO
